results.remarks:
Tucked behind private gates in one of Willow Glen's most established communities, this single-level 2-bedroom, 2-bath home delivers something increasingly rare in Silicon Valley: genuine space, resort-style amenities, and a setting that actually feels calm at the end of the day.

At 1,091 square feet, the floor plan lives open and bright, with vinyl plank flooring running throughout for a clean, durable, low-maintenance finish. The remodeled kitchen is the standout, with updated cabinetry, fresh countertops, and generous prep and storage space, opening to the living and dining areas so the cook is never cut off from the conversation. Both full bathrooms have been remodeled as well, finished with contemporary fixtures and updated tile that make the daily routine feel like an upgrade.

The living room centers on a sleek electric fireplace, adding warmth and ambiance without the mess or maintenance of wood. Sliding doors open to a private balcony, extending the living space outdoors and offering a quiet spot for morning coffee or an evening wind-down above the treetops. Two comfortable bedrooms sit off the main living area, each with ample closet space, and the second full bath means guests and household members never have to negotiate a morning schedule.

Practical touches round out the package: in-unit laundry, additional storage, gated covered carport parking, and dedicated guest parking for visitors.

Step outside your door and the community does the rest. Residents enjoy a sparkling pool, spa, sauna, tennis courts, a clubhouse for gatherings, and beautifully maintained grounds with mature landscaping throughout. The HOA covers water, garbage, sewer, roof, exterior paint, common area maintenance, landscaping, and the full amenity package, making budgeting refreshingly simple.

The location is the quiet advantage. You are minutes from the Fruitdale VTA Green Line station for a car-free commute, with San Jose City College and Santa Clara Valley Medical Center just up the road. Downtown Willow Glen's shops, cafes, and restaurants along Lincoln Avenue are a short drive away, as are Santana Row and Westfield Valley Fair for shopping and dining. Commuters get fast access to Highways 280, 880, 87, and 17, plus Diridon Station and the SAP Center.

Move-in ready, low-maintenance, and priced to be one of the best values in the 95126, this is Silicon Valley living without the Silicon Valley upkeep. Come see it before it is gone.
